- if they differ, output the color shared by the two panels (a color present in both panels; in the demonstrated tasks this is the common/base color).

The panels may be stacked (e.g. 29x2 input means 14 rows, divider row, 14 rows) or side-by-side (e.g. 29x19 means 9 columns, divider column, 9 columns). Locate the solid divider, then align panels without reversing/flipping.
